# Third-party: hermes-memory-session-scope (slot 426)

Written 2026-10-28 22:00 (+01:00) Europe/Zagreb.

No new crates, no vendored or copied code, Cargo.lock unchanged. The `scope` field and the
session filter use the existing `rusqlite` / `serde_json` already in openmind-memory and
hermes-rs (licences as recorded in docs/third-party/hermes-rs-memory-client.md and the
openmind-memory docs). Hermes (OpenRouter) was not used for this slot.
